ai.title: Add tests for diff block parsing edge cases
ai.summary: Added unit tests for `parseAndGetDiffBlocksSingleFile` covering multiline imports and Python-style indentation mismatches. Includes new `test.knowledge.md` documenting guidelines for testing whitespace and indentation preservation. Changes restricted to `test/__src__/` directory.

eli5.text: The team added safety checks to how the system reads and compares old and new versions of code so that tricky formatting, like multiline imports and Python's indentation-sensitive code, is matched correctly. These checks are invisible to you if you use the tool, but they make sure the system reliably recognizes code changes even when spacing and line breaks vary, reducing the chance of a search-and-replace missing its target.

ai.title: Clarify referral banner and page copy
ai.summary: Referral copy simplified on web. Banner text now explicitly states the {CREDITS_REFERRAL_BONUS} credit reward for both parties, importing the constant from common/constants. Referrals page splits the call-to-action, moving 'Send this link to them:' to a separate paragraph. Changes limited to web/src/app/referrals/page.tsx and web/src/components/ui/banner.tsx.

eli5.text: When you visit the referrals page, you'll now see the credit amount split into its own line, followed by a separate line that says 'Send this link to them:' instead of both phrases jumbled together in one paragraph. The same credit amount also now appears in the site-wide banner at the top, where it previously just said 'earn free credits' without stating how many. Both spots pull that number from a single shared setting, so if the reward ever changes, every place that mentions it updates at once. The change is live today on the web app.

ai.title: Add Stripe customer portal cancel link to pricing page
ai.summary: Pricing page pro tier card now renders a cancel link pointing to NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_CUSTOMER_PORTAL when subscription_active is true. Replaces buttonText/buttonAction props with cardFooterChildren across free, pro, and enterprise tiers to support custom button layouts and conditional rendering. Adds NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_CUSTOMER_PORTAL to web/src/env.mjs runtime validation as a required URL. Pro tier support text updated to mention Discord alongside email.

eli5.text: You: Visitors to the pricing page who already pay for the Pro plan now see a link they can click to leave the Pro plan themselves, instead of needing to ask support. That link only appears when the page can confirm an active paid subscription. The site also quietly added a required address it needs in order to send people to the right place, and updated the Pro plan's support note to say help comes over email or Discord. The wording change is visible to every visitor reading the plan details; the cancel link is visible only to current Pro subscribers when they visit the page.

ai.title: Fix pricing card footer width alignment
ai.summary: Added `w-full` to `cardFooterChildren` container in `web/src/app/pricing/page.tsx`. Ensures consistent width for pricing card footers.

eli5.text: The pricing page had a small alignment issue where the footer area of each plan card wasn't stretching to full width, making the layout look slightly uneven. Now the footer content, including the call-to-action buttons, is adjusted to fill the entire width of its card, giving the pricing section a cleaner and more consistent appearance. You'd notice this if you were viewing the pricing page today, as the buttons and text in the footers now align properly from edge to edge.
